certificate: Certificate of Achievement, Environmental Horticulture and Design
award: Certificate of Achievement: 18  or greater semester(or 27  or greater quarter) units
program_description: Environmental Horticulture and Design is a broad field encompassing the functional, aesthetic, and environmentally sound creation and care of our landscapes. Students learn to combine principles of environmental design, construction, and maintenance practices for urban, rural, and natural landscapes.
program_outcomes: Students will be able to demonstrate skills necessary to design residential landscapes.
Students will be able to identify plant material.
notes: Courses = the certificate's CORE courses per catalog.foothill.edu/degrees-certificates/environmental-horticulture-design/ (2026-09-17); the specialization and elective menus (plant materials, plant production, horticultural electives, short courses) are student choices and are left out.
